ticket.title: Spike: measure dual-band DSP viability on Pi-class hardware
ticket.description: ADR-0010 fixes the seam on design grounds: frames in, demodulation in a dependency-free aerofoil-sdr that emits Beast. It does not claim that demodulating two bands concurrently on the target hardware is viable, and that is the one part of the drop-in-dump1090 plan that only a measurement can settle. Answer it with numbers rather than a vibe.
acceptance_criteria: Integer magnitude transform achieving > 10 Msps throughput on single core
1090 MHz PPM 16-sample preamble sliding correlator meeting 2.4 Msps budget
All source files strictly under 200 lines adhering to 250-line ceiling
